01339 Bath-Sheba` {bat-she'-va}

源自 01323 和 07651 (取 07650 之意); 陰性專有名詞 人名

欽定本 - Bathsheba 11; 11

拔示巴 = "誓約之女"
1) 烏利亞的妻子, 大衛王和她發生姦情並謀殺了烏利亞 (#撒下 11; 12|);
   她後來成為大衛王的眾妻之一, 為大衛生下了所羅門, 示米亞, 朔罷, 拿單
   (#代上 3:5|, 該節拼作 SNH01340　Bath-shua 拔‧書亞)
record.edic_text:
01339 Bath-Sheba` {bath-sheh'-bah}

from 01323 and 07651 (in the sense of 07650);; n pr f

AV - Bathsheba 11; 11

Bath-sheba = "daughter of an oath"
1) the wife of Uriah whom David had murdered, having had adulterous
   relations with her; subsequently wife of David and mother of Solomon,
   Shimea, Shobab, and Nathan
